title: Bigger glossary, basketball picks unblocked
items: The Learn glossary grows from 14 terms to 35: home edge, résumé, model-only probability, agreement and disagreement, spread, total, lock, graded, hit rate, expected hit rate, Upset watch, AP Top 25, Personal Ballot, the four basketball factors one by one, bracketology, automatic bid, bubble and First Four.
A basketball-only update no longer stops because of football results it does not change. Missing midweek football finals had blocked basketball forecasts from being published for the weekend.
